groups.title: Use
items: Keep the active outcome in the label.
Use immediate feedback when value changes.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for multi-select choices.
Do not hide policy meaning in helper text only.
Do not use when a Save step owns the final value.

groups.title: Review
items: Confirm high-impact settings with the human owner.
Test keyboard and screen reader state.
Check label wrapping at narrow widths.
